label: Contests won share
definition: Share of the match's contests (duels, 50/50s, second balls) won by the team.

label: Field tilt
definition: Share of the match's passes and carries in the opponent's final third.

label: Chances share
definition: Team non-penalty xG as a share of the match's non-penalty xG.

label: Overall dominance
definition: Mean of the contests, field tilt and chances shares.

label: Tackles won share
definition: Share of the match's tackle duels won by the team.

label: Aerial duels won share
definition: Share of the match's aerial duels won by the team (each aerial counted once).

label: 50/50s won share
definition: Share of the match's 50/50 contests won by the team (each contest counted once).

label: Second balls won share
definition: Share of the match's loose-ball recoveries made by the team.

label: Aerials won above difficulty
definition: Aerials won minus the HOPS win probability summed over the team's aerials (positive = more won than their difficulty predicts).

label: Passes and carries in the final third
definition: The team's passes and carries in the opponent's final third (x >= 80).

label: Non-penalty xG
definition: Non-penalty expected goals created in the match.

label: Non-penalty xG conceded
definition: Non-penalty expected goals conceded in the match.

label: Conversion
unit: xG per unit of field tilt
definition: Non-penalty xG divided by field-tilt share (empty when field tilt is 0).

label: Security
definition: Non-penalty xG conceded per opponent entry into the team's defensive third (completed passes and carries starting x < 80 and ending x >= 80 in the opponent's coordinates); empty with no entries.

label: Defensive work per point of dominance
definition: Defensive actions (pressures, tackles, interceptions, fouls committed, blocks) per percentage point of dominance.

label: High-speed running without the ball per point of dominance
definition: High-speed running without the ball (metres over 20 km/h, tracking) per percentage point of dominance.

label: Minutes outside the most-used 11
definition: Share of the team's minutes in the match played by players outside its 11 players with most tournament minutes.

label: Starters changed from the previous match
definition: Number of starters who did not start the team's previous match.

label: Top-3 players' share of high-speed running
definition: The three highest players' share of the team's high-speed running in the match (tracking).

label: Top-2 players' share of xG + xA
definition: Share of the team's xG plus xA from its two highest contributors in the match.

label: Spread of chance creation across zones
definition: Normalised entropy of the team's xG (shot zone) plus xA (assisting pass zone) across the 18 pitch zones (1 = evenly spread, 0 = one zone).

label: Possession share
definition: Share of the match's possession time (first to last event of each possession, periods 1-2).

label: Pressures per minute of opponent possession
definition: Pressures per minute of opponent possession time.

label: Directness
definition: Mean StatsBomb possession directness over the team's possessions with a value.

label: Total distance
definition: Team total distance covered (FIFA physical file).

label: High-speed running
definition: Team distance above 20 km/h (FIFA physical file: 20-25 and 25+ km/h bands).

label: High-speed running without the ball
definition: Team distance faster than 20 km/h while the opponent had the ball (tracking).

label: Match number
definition: The team's match number in the tournament (1 = first match).

label: Starters' built-up minutes
definition: Minutes the starting eleven had played in the tournament before this match.

label: Rest days
definition: Days since the team's previous match (missing for the first match).

label: Points above expectation
definition: Actual points minus expected points from the Elo-based model (shootouts count as draws).

label: Expected points
definition: Expected points from the leave-team-out ordered logit on the Elo gap.

label: Actual points
definition: Points won: 3 win, 1 draw (including shootouts), 0 loss.

label: Expected assists (xA)
definition: Non-penalty xG of the shots assisted by the team's passes.

label: Opponent entries into the defensive third
definition: Opponent completed passes and carries into the team's defensive third (starting x < 80, ending x >= 80 in the opponent's coordinates).

label: Pressures
definition: Pressures applied by the team.

label: Defensive actions
definition: Pressures, tackles, interceptions, fouls committed and blocks by the team.

label: Possession time
definition: The team's possession time in the match.

label: Players used
definition: Players with minutes in the match.

label: Passes allowed per defensive action (PPDA)
definition: Opponent passes in their own 60% of the pitch per team tackle, interception, foul committed or block in that area (lower = more intense pressing).

label: Sprinting
definition: Team distance above 25 km/h (FIFA physical file).

label: Total distance (tracking)
definition: Team total distance from tracking (speed / 25 per frame).

label: High-speed running (tracking)
definition: Team distance faster than 20 km/h from tracking.

label: High-speed running with the ball
definition: Team distance faster than 20 km/h while the team had the ball (tracking); with the ball, without it and out of play add up to high-speed running (tracking).

label: High-speed running with the ball out of play
definition: Team distance faster than 20 km/h while the ball was out of play (tracking).

label: High-speed running without the ball in the defensive third
definition: Team distance faster than 20 km/h without the ball in its own third (tracking).

label: Defensive line height
definition: Mean distance from own goal of the four deepest outfield players, once a second, averaged over seconds without the ball (tracking).

label: Team length
definition: Distance from the deepest to the highest outfield player, once a second, averaged over seconds without the ball (tracking).

label: Team width
definition: Widest outfield spread across the pitch, once a second, averaged over seconds without the ball (tracking).

label: FIFA phase: build-up
definition: The team's FIFA clip time in build-up over its clip time in all 11 FIFA phases (FIFA Enhanced file; a second counts in every clip covering it).

label: FIFA phase: progression
definition: The team's FIFA clip time in progression over its clip time in all 11 FIFA phases (FIFA Enhanced file; a second counts in every clip covering it).

label: FIFA phase: final third
definition: The team's FIFA clip time in final third over its clip time in all 11 FIFA phases (FIFA Enhanced file; a second counts in every clip covering it).

label: FIFA phase: long ball
definition: The team's FIFA clip time in long ball over its clip time in all 11 FIFA phases (FIFA Enhanced file; a second counts in every clip covering it).

label: FIFA phase: attacking transition
definition: The team's FIFA clip time in attacking transition over its clip time in all 11 FIFA phases (FIFA Enhanced file; a second counts in every clip covering it).

label: FIFA phase: counter attack
definition: The team's FIFA clip time in counter attack over its clip time in all 11 FIFA phases (FIFA Enhanced file; a second counts in every clip covering it).

label: FIFA phase: press
definition: The team's FIFA clip time in press over its clip time in all 11 FIFA phases (FIFA Enhanced file; a second counts in every clip covering it).

label: FIFA phase: counter-press
definition: The team's FIFA clip time in counter-press over its clip time in all 11 FIFA phases (FIFA Enhanced file; a second counts in every clip covering it).

label: FIFA phase: defensive transition
definition: The team's FIFA clip time in defensive transition over its clip time in all 11 FIFA phases (FIFA Enhanced file; a second counts in every clip covering it).

label: FIFA phase: recovery
definition: The team's FIFA clip time in recovery over its clip time in all 11 FIFA phases (FIFA Enhanced file; a second counts in every clip covering it).

label: FIFA phase: block
definition: The team's FIFA clip time in block over its clip time in all 11 FIFA phases (FIFA Enhanced file; a second counts in every clip covering it).
